notes.title: Floridale Man: The Joy of Development Updates, Issue 1
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone! It’s been a bit. We’ve got some [i][b]UPDATES[/b][/i] for y’all![/h1]

[b]First up: We’re going to Anime NYC next week, August 23-25![/b] We’ll be there with our friends at Play NYC exhibiting in the Gaming Hall. It’s our first time showing Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos off in public, and we’re hyped. Please stop by and say hi if you’ll be in town! We’ll update you with the exact location of our booth on the floor as soon as we’re able. You can learn more on the Anime NYC website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037479/13a1063185823d9653c0295d9edfe0088844bb2b.png[/img]
Shout out to my mom back home for holding onto all our booth stuff for us.

[b]Second: We’re launching a Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos Kickstarter![/b] Please pre-save our campaign when you get the chance. You’ll be notified when the Kickstarter officially launches, and your early support would mean so much to us.

As far as dev goes, we’re still hard at work! Things feel like they’re really starting to come together over here. We’re updating the UI, adding new character models to the game, designing levels, and setting every NPC on fire in playtests. [i](Ok, at least that’s what I do in playtests.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037479/0fc80b3efaca828a866c20b1cd65bee4069ac034.gif[/img]

That’s all we’ve got for now. Thanks again for your support as we’ve been working hard to make the game happen. We’ll have some more news for you in the coming weeks, but in the meantime, please wishlist our game if you haven’t yet! It would mean so much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925460/Floridale_Man_The_Joy_of_Chaos/
